integrity: The proof is symbolic. It uses the published FSP-ultrafilter equivalence and adds a finite pigeonhole/diagonalization argument. No numerical experiment, sampling argument, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only finite idealized eventually-different families. It does not classify infinite FSP families, definability levels, or exact cardinal invariants for the infinite Stone-space hierarchy.
title: Finite-section productivity of finite idealized MED families has an exact fiber criterion
